blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Activation steering offers a lightweight mechanism for controlling model behavior, but existing methods depend on sentence-level contrastive data that is unavailable for most of the world's languages. We show that multilingual sentiment lexicons are a viable substitute across three model families: aggregated multilingual lexicons outperform English-derived steering vectors for mid- and low-resource languages, while monolingual lexicons remain stronger for languages a model has specialized in during pre-training. The steering efficacy is mechanistically dictated by both representational density and pre-training priors. Large-magnitude English vectors overwhelm the compact representations of low-resource languages, causing "linguistic collapse." This fragility is mitigated by the norm-dampening of multilingual aggregation. Architectural biases, including bilingual specialization penalty and latent numerical rigidity, also heavily constrain cross-lingual steering responsiveness. Ultimately, our work establishes lexicons as a practical steering signal and offers a comprehensive mechanistic account of cross-lingual steering dynamics.
blocks.zh: 活性向导为控制模型行为提供了一个轻量级机制,但现有方法依赖于大多数世界语言都不具备的句子级对比数据. 我们显示,多语种情绪词汇是三个模式家庭的可行替代语:综合多语种词汇优于中低资源语言的英语导向矢量,而单一语言词汇对于在预训期间专门使用的语言来说仍然更强。 引导效果由代表密度和培训前的先行程度决定。 大宽度英语向量压倒了低资源语言的紧凑表现,导致"语言崩溃". 这种脆弱性通过规范地推广多语种汇总而得到缓解。 结构上的偏见,包括双语专业惩罚和潜在的数字僵硬性,也严重制约了跨语言的引导反应能力。 归根结底,我们的工作将词汇确定为实用的指导信号,并全面说明各种语言的指导动态。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Activation engineering has emerged as a lightweight method for controlling model outputs by manipulating internal activation vectors during inference, without modifying model weights or requiring curated training data ( turner:2024 ; rimsky:2024 ; arditi:2024 ; zou:2025 ) . By identifying linear directions associated with specific concepts (e.g., “sentiment”), one can steer the model’s behavior directly. In the context of sentiment-controlled generation, several studies have adopted activation engineering as an alternative to fine-tuning-based approaches ( turner:2024 ; liu:2024 ; konen:2024 ) . Despite its promise, current sentiment steering methodologies are constrained by a reliance on sentence-level supervision and evaluation benchmarks optimized for English-centric corpora. This dependence creates a significant barrier for low-resource languages, where high-quality sentiment-labeled sentence corpora are scarce or non-existent, leaving most of the world’s languages outside the reach of existing steering methods.
blocks.zh: 活化工程已作为一种轻量级方法出现,通过在推论中操纵内部活化向量来控制模型输出,而无需修改模型重量或需要被整理的训练数据(转子:2024;Rimsky:2024;alditi:2024;zou:2025). 通过确定与具体概念(如"sentiment")相关的线性方向,可以直接引导模型的行为. 在情绪控制生成的背景下,有好几项研究采用活化工程作为取而代之的微调方法(turner:2024;liu:2024;konen:2024). 尽管它有希望,但当前情绪指导方法受到制约,因为依赖以英语为中心的公司最优化的判刑一级监督和评价基准。 这种依赖性为低资源语言设置了重大障碍,因为高品质的情感标记句子corpora很少或根本不存在,使世界上大多数语言无法利用现有的指导方法。

blocks.en: The effectiveness of these interventions across diverse languages also remains largely unexplored. This gap is critical because LLMs exhibit varying degrees of cross-lingual isomorphism: the extent to which semantic concepts share a similar geometric representation across languages ( lample:2018 ) . In models with strong “Anglocentric” bias, a sentiment vector derived from English may be orthogonal to, or incongruent with, the sentiment subspace of low-resource languages like Javanese or Hausa, mirroring findings on the lack of isomorphism in low-resource cross-lingual embeddings ( sannigrahi:2022 ) . Relying solely on monolingual sentence-derived vectors thus constrains the scalability of activation steering in multilingual contexts.
blocks.zh: 各种语文的这些干预措施的效力也基本上没有得到探讨。 这一差距至关重要,因为LLMs表现出了不同程度的跨语言同位素:语义概念在语言之间具有相近几何表达(灯:2018)的程度. 在具有强烈"盎格鲁中心"偏向的模型中,从英语中衍生出的一种情绪矢量可能与Javanese或Hauusa等低资源语言的情绪子空间有正交性或相通性,这反映了在低资源跨语言嵌入(sannigrahi:2022)中缺乏同位素的发现. 完全依赖单一语言的句子衍生向量,从而限制了多语种背景下活化向导的可扩展性。

blocks.en: In this work, we propose multilingual sentiment lexicons as a scalable, resource-efficient signal for cross-lingual activation steering. Our contributions are as follows: (1) A lexicon-based steering framework. We formalize activation steering via multilingual sentiment lexicons (illustrated in Figure 1 ), eliminating the need for sentence-level annotations or paired contrastive prompts. (2) Systematic cross-lingual evaluation. We benchmark monolingual versus multilingual lexicon steering across 11 11 typologically diverse languages spanning high-, mid-, and low-resource tiers and three model families. We show that aggregated multilingual lexicons outperform English-derived steering vectors for most mid- and low-resource languages, while monolingual lexicons remain superior in narrower cases where a model is heavily specialized in a particular language. (3) Mechanistic analysis of cross-lingual steering dynamics. We demonstrate that steering success is dictated by a model’s pre-training priors and latent scale disparities. We show that large-norm English vectors cause linguistic collapse by overwhelming the compact latent subspaces of low-resource languages, whereas multilingual aggregation produces more balanced vectors that eliminate this mismatch and prevent representation collapse. Furthermore, we reveal how architectural biases determine a model’s responsiveness to cross-lingual interventions.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出多语种情绪词典,作为跨语言激活方向的可伸缩,资源效率高的信号. 我们的捐款如下: (1) 基于词汇的指导框架。 我们通过多语种情绪词典(图1中标注)将激活方向正规化,从而不再需要句子层次的说明或对齐的对比提示. (2)系统跨语言评价. 我们以单一语言和多语言词汇为基准,指导11种类型多样的语言,跨越高、中、低资源层次和三个模范家庭。 我们显示,在大多数中低资源语言中,汇总的多语种词汇优于英语衍生的引导向量,而单一语言词汇在较窄的情况下仍然优于某一语言的模式。 (3)跨语言指导动力学的机械分析. 我们表明,指导成功取决于一个模式的培训前事迹和潜在的规模差异。 我们显示,英语大调矢量通过压倒低资源语言的紧凑潜伏子空间而导致语言崩溃,而多语种聚合则产生更平衡的矢量,消除了这种不匹配并避免了代表性崩溃. 此外,我们揭示了建筑偏见如何决定一个模型对跨语言干预的反应。

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en: Controllable Text Generation ( CTG ) is the task of generating natural sentences that adhere to certain attributes ( prabhumoye:2020 ) . According to liang:2024 , CTG methods can be classified based on the stage at which the intervention occurs: the training stage (e.g. retraining, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning) and the inference stage (e.g. prompt engineering, latent space manipulation, decoding-time intervention). Although training phase methods provide high-fidelity control, they are often constrained by high computational costs and substantial data requirements, making them impractical for low-resource language settings, where the extensive corpora required for effective training are unavailable. In this paper, we utilize the latent space manipulation (also known as activation engineering) method to exploit language model’s underlying semantic geometry, potentially offering a more universal and robust framework for cross-lingual control.
blocks.zh: 可控文本生成(CTG)是生成坚持某些属性的自然句子(pubhumoye:2020.)的任务. 根据"梁:2024",CTG方法可以根据干预的发生阶段进行分类:培训阶段(如再培训,微调,强化学习)和推论阶段(如即时工程,潜在空间操纵,解码时间干预). 虽然培训阶段的方法提供了高可靠性控制,但它们往往受到高计算成本和大量数据要求的限制,因此,对于缺乏有效培训所需的广泛团队的低资源语言环境来说,这些方法是不切实际的。 在本文中,我们利用潜在的空间操纵(也称为活化工程)方法来利用语言模型的基本语义几何学,这有可能为跨语言控制提供一个更普遍更强有力的框架。

The h ⁡ ( “Love” ) − h ⁡ ( “Hate” ) h(\text{``Love''})-h(\text{``Hate''}) steering direction is then added during forward pass at inference time to shift the activations to generate positive sentiment completions. blocks.en: Our method for deriving the sentiment steering direction is most similar to the Activation-based Style Vectors technique, in contrast to the other two approaches discussed. This technique extends the concept of Activation Addition by calculating a general style vector for a specific category s ∈ S s\in S . This is achieved by computing the difference between the mean activation of sentences in style category s s and the mean activation of all sentences in the remaining style categories, S ∖ s S\setminus s . In this study, instead of relying on labeled sentiment datasets such as Yelp Review ( zhang:2015 ) , we utilize sentiment lexicons consisting of positive and negative words to address the inherent data scarcity in low-resource language settings.
blocks.zh: 与所讨论的其他两种方法相比,我们得出情绪方向的方法与基于激活的样式矢量技术最相类似。 此技术通过计算特定类别 s QQ S\in S 的通式向量来扩展活性加法的概念. 这是通过计算样式 s 类中句子平均活化与剩余样式类别中句子平均活化,S QQ s S\setminus s. 在这项研究中,我们不依靠Yelp Review(zhang:2015)等标注的情绪数据集,而是使用由正词和负词组成的情绪词典来解决低资源语言环境中固有的数据稀缺问题.

blocks.en: Rather than modifying model weights through fine-tuning, activation engineering exploits the pre-existing representations within the language model. It relies on the Linear Representation Hypothesis, assuming that semantic attributes are encoded as linear directions, thus allowing for direct steering within the representation space ( park:2024 ) . Previous research by tigges:2024 has shown that language models linearly represent sentiment, where methods like k k -means, linear probing, and Distributed Alignment Search ( DAS ), originally introduced by geiger:2024 , converge on a similar sentiment direction. dipalma:2025 further corroborates this by unveiling linearly probe-able sentiment and emotion representations specifically within the Llama model family. We extend these findings by investigating the cross-lingual universality of sentiment directions; specifically, whether lexicon-derived sentiment directions align in a shared representation space across multiple languages. We primarily utilize the difference-in-means method to derive sentiment directions, complemented by linear probing to evaluate the consistency of sentiment representation across model layers.
blocks.zh: 活化工程与其通过微调来修改模型权重,不如利用语言模型内原有的表示. 它依赖于线性表达假说,假设语义属性被编码为线性取向,从而允许在表达空间(park:2024)内直接取向. 由tigges:2024之前的研究显示,语言模型线性地代表了情感,其中K-意指,线性探测等方法以及最初由geiger:2024所引入的分布式对齐搜索(DAS)等方法在类似情绪方向上趋同. Dipalma:2025进一步证实了这一点,在Llama模型家族中专门揭示出线性可探测的情绪和情感表现. 我们通过调查情绪方向的跨语言普遍性来扩大这些结论;具体来说,词汇衍生的情绪方向是否在多种语言的共同代表空间中一致。 我们主要利用不同含义的方法来得出情绪方向,辅之以线性测试来评价各模型层情绪表达的一致性。

blocks.en: The findings by liuzhu:2024 suggest that in generative language models, lexical semantics are highly concentrated in the lower layers. By evaluating hidden states on the Word in Context (WiC) benchmark, they demonstrate that lower layers manage contextual disambiguation (determining whether identical words convey the same meaning in distinct contexts), while higher layers shift computational focus toward next-token prediction. In contrast, our approach evaluates semantic polarity without surrounding context. We isolate the sentiment axis by extracting global representations directly from uncontextualized lexicon entries, which can range from single words to multi-word phrases. Because semantic encoding varies significantly across network depth ( liuzhu:2024 ) , mapping these isolated representations layer-by-layer allows us to empirically identify the optimal intervention point for cross-lingual sentiment steering using a multilingual lexicon.

blocks.en: While the Linear Representation Hypothesis suggests stable sentiment directions within a single language, recent evaluations highlight that the generalization and reliability of steering vectors can degrade significantly under out-of-distribution shifts ( tan:2025 ) . Because cross-lingual transfer inherently represents a massive distributional shift, the capacity of these vectors to generalize zero-shot across languages remains a critical open question. Ideally, multilingual LLMs would exhibit cross-lingual isomorphism, where semantic spaces across languages share a similar geometric structure ( lample:2018 ) . This phenomenon was first empirically observed in massively multilingual encoders like mBERT ( devlin:2019 ) and XLM-R ( conneau:2020 ) , which demonstrated that pre-training on a shared vocabulary across 100 + 100+ languages naturally induces a “universal” representation space where semantically similar tokens align across languages without explicit translation supervision ( libovicky:2020 ; pires:2019 ) . Under this assumption, a sentiment direction derived in English should theoretically transfer to other languages.
blocks.zh: 虽然线性表达假说表明一种语言内情绪方向稳定,但最近的评价强调,在分配外的转变(晒出:2025)下,方向矢量的通化和可靠性可以显著地降解. 由于跨语言的传入本质上代表了巨大的分布性转变,这些向量在语言中通俗化零发的能力仍然是一个关键的未决问题. 理想的情况是,多种语言的LLMS将展现出跨语言同位素,语言之间的语义空间具有相近的几何结构(灯:2018 ). 这种现象首先在mBERT(devlin:2019)和XLM-R(conneau:2020)等大规模多语种编码器中经验地被观察到,这表明,在100+100+语言中共享词汇的预训自然会产生一种“普遍”代表空间,在这种空间中,类似符号在没有明确翻译监督的情况下在各种语言之间一致(liboviky:2020;pires:2019)。 根据这一假设,从理论上讲,从英语中得出的情绪方向应该转移到其他语言。

blocks.en: Despite the assumption of a universal space, pre-training on unbalanced corpora frequently produces an “Anglocentric” internal structure ( ahuja:2023 ; lauscher:2020 ) . Within this structure, high-resource languages align closely with English subspaces, whereas mid-to-low resource languages suffer from weaker alignment or severe representation degeneration. This representational gap directly challenges cross-lingual steering; if the “sentiment axis” in a low-resource language is disjoint from the English axis, monolingual steering will fail. This geometric misalignment remains intrinsically tied to the model’s underlying linguistic proficiency. Multilingual architectures rely on language-specific neurons to map inputs into the shared semantic space and decode them back into target vocabularies ( tang:2024 ) . Without robust neurons for low-resource languages, a severe projection bottleneck emerges, suggesting that the model’s limited linguistic proficiency acts as a critical constraint on cross-lingual control, independent of the latent steering mechanism’s geometric accuracy.
blocks.zh: 尽管假设了普遍空间,但不平衡的蝎子的预训经常产生出一个"英格鲁中心"的内部结构(hauja:2023;lauscher:2020.). 在这个结构内,高资源语言与英语子空间紧密相接,而中低资源语言则受到较弱的校正或严重的代表分化. 这一代表性差距直接挑战了跨语言方向;如果低资源语言中的“感应轴”与英语轴脱节,单一语言方向将失败。 这种几何错位仍然与模型的基本语言能力有着内在的联系. 多语言架构依靠语言上特有的神经元来将输入到共享的语义空间并解码为回向目标词汇(tang:2024). 没有低资源语言的强势神经元,就出现了严重的投影瓶颈,表明该模型的语言熟练程度有限,是对跨语言控制的关键制约,独立于潜在引导机制的几何精度。

blocks.en: Operating under these constraints, we propose that aggregation of multilingual lexicons can serve as a geometric bridge. We hypothesize that if the underlying alignment is sufficiently preserved, a multilingual direction can reinforce the shared sentiment direction via coherent reinforcement. Conversely, in cases of extreme representation degeneration, such aggregation may fail to overcome the lack of semantic grounding.
blocks.zh: 在这些限制下运作,我们建议集合多语种词汇可以充当几何桥. 我们假设,如果充分保持基本的一致,多语种方向就可以通过连贯地加强共同的情绪方向。 相反地,在代表性极低的情况下,这种综合可能无法克服语义上的缺乏。

blocks.en: 3.1 Sentiment Direction Extraction
blocks.zh: 3.1 定点取出

blocks.en: Among the various methods for obtaining steering direction, difference-in-means is one of the most simple, yet effective approach ( marks:2024 ; belrose:2023 ) . To extract the steering direction corresponding to sentiment attribute, we employ the difference-in-means method using two opposing sets of lexicon entries (phrases), denoted as ℒ + \mathcal{L}^{+} and ℒ − \mathcal{L}^{-} .
blocks.zh: 在获取方向方向的各种方法中,不同指向是最简单但有效的方法之一(标记:2024;belrose:2023). 为了提取与情感属性相对应的向导方向,我们使用两套对立的词典条目(用词),表示为L +\mathcal{L}^{+}和L-\mathcal{L}^{-}的同义异同法.

blocks.en:
Let 𝒱 \mathcal{V} denote the model’s vocabulary consisting of individual tokens.
Recognizing that modern language models utilize sub-word tokenization (e.g., Byte-Pair Encoding), a single word or phrase in a lexicon may be decomposed into multiple tokens.
We therefore define a lexicon entry l l as a sequence of tokens l = ( t 1 , t 2 , … , t | l | ) l=(t_{1},t_{2},\dots,t_{|l|}) , where each t j ∈ 𝒱 t_{j}\in\mathcal{V} and | l | ≥ 1 |l|\geq 1 represents the length of the entry. For example, the word “abhorrence” is tokenized into ( “ab” , “hor” , “rence” ) (\text{``ab''},\text{``hor''},\text{``rence''}) using Qwen-3 ’s tokenizer. Accordingly, we define two contrastive sets of lexicon entries: • ℒ + = { l 1 + , l 2 + , … , l N + } \mathcal{L}^{+}=\{l_{1}^{+},l_{2}^{+},\dots,l_{N}^{+}\} representing the positive lexicon set; and • ℒ − = { l 1 − , l 2 − , … , l M − } \mathcal{L}^{-}=\{l_{1}^{-},l_{2}^{-},\dots,l_{M}^{-}\} representing the negative lexicon set.

blocks.en: In the context of activation steering, probing is frequently employed to identify the model components that contribute most significantly to the target attribute, thereby enabling more targeted interventions. For instance, li:2023 and wang:2025 utilize probes to select specific attention heads for steering, while konen:2024 employ probing to determine the optimal layers for intervention. Building upon these approaches, we propose a two-stage feature attribution mechanism: we first identify the layers with the highest sentiment density, and then isolate a sparse subset of neurons within those layers that contribute most significantly to the sentiment representation.
blocks.zh: 在激活引导方面,经常采用探测方法来确定最有助于目标属性的模型组件,从而能够采取更有针对性的干预措施。 例如:li:2023和wang:2025利用探测器来选择方向盘的特定注意头,而konen:2024则使用探测器来确定干预的最佳层. 在这些方法的基础上,我们提出一个两个阶段的特征归属机制:我们首先确定情绪密度最高的地层,然后在这些地层中隔离出一小部分对情绪表现作用最大的神经元.

Since probing in isolation can capture non-causal correlations rather than true task relevance ( ravichander:2021 ; saphra:2024 ) , we conduct rigorous intervention experiments against random baselines, fully detailed in the Appendix I .

blocks.en: Steering all neurons within a selected layer may introduce unnecessary noise. Our preliminary experiments with Qwen and Llama indicate that this selection is an empirical necessity; unconstrained steering frequently resulting in incoherent, ‘gibberish’ outputs. To mitigate this, we perform neuron-level attribution using Gradient Boosted Decision Trees ( GBDT ) via XGBoost . While sparsity-inducing linear probes (e.g., L1-regularized Logistic Regression) can reduce feature counts, they typically retain a broader set of neurons based on linear separability. In contrast, tree-based models perform a more aggressive, non-linear feature selection, isolating a highly compact subset of neurons highly discriminative for sentiment representation.

blocks.en: We evaluate three base LLMs: Llama-3.2-3B ( llama:2025 ) , Gemma-3-4B-PT ( gemma:2025 ) , and Qwen3-4B-Base ( qwen:2025 ) . To derive steering directions, we utilize the NRC-VAD lexicon ( nrc-vad:2018 ) , which provides human-rated valence scores [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . We apply strict thresholds ( > 0.8 >0.8 for ℒ + \mathcal{L}^{+} and < 0.2 <0.2 for ℒ − \mathcal{L}^{-} ) to maximize semantic contrast and ensure robust steering vectors. We compare two configurations: Monolingual (English only) and Multilingual , which aggregates and deduplicates lexicons across 11 typologically diverse languages spanning three resource tiers: high-resource (English, German, Chinese, Japanese), mid-resource (Indonesian, Icelandic, Estonian, Basque), and low-resource (Hausa, Javanese, Sundanese). Detailed preprocessing and model configurations are provided in Appendix A .

blocks.en: We evaluate cross-lingual steering on an open-ended generation task: given a neutral prompt, the model generates a continuation, and we measure whether steering shifts the sentiment of the generated text toward the target polarity while preserving the language of the prompt. To support this evaluation, we constructed a large-scale suite of 11,000 11{,}000 neutral prompts across 11 11 languages. We first generated 1,000 1{,}000 unique neutral English prompts using a hierarchical structure ( 10 10 categories × \times 10 10 topics × \times 10 10 prompts per topic), then translated them into 10 10 target languages using Gemini . For low-resource languages, we employed style-guided prompts (e.g., specifying Javanese Ngoko Lugu and Sundanese Basa Loma) to strictly maintain a natural, conversational style. To ensure baseline reliability, we manually audited a 10 % 10\% random sample ( 100 100 prompts) of the unique English set (see Appendix A.2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价跨语言指导的开放式世代任务:如果一个中立的瞬间,模型会产生延续性,我们衡量方向是否将生成的文本的情绪转向目标极性,同时保留瞬间的语言. 为了支持这次评估,我们建造了一套11 000个11{}000个中性提示的大型套装,覆盖了11个11个语言。 我们首先使用分级结构生成了1000个 1{,}000个独特的中性英语提示(10个类别 ×\times 10个专题 ×\times 10个专题 ×\times 10个10个提示),然后使用双子座语言将其翻译为10个目标语言. 对于低资源语言,我们使用风格指导的提示(例如,指定Javanese Ngoko Lugu和Sundanese Basa Loma)来严格地保持一种自然的,对话的风格. 为确保基线可靠性,我们手动审计了独有的英语集的10%-10-%随机抽样(100-100 英制)(见附录A.2 )。

blocks.en:
To assess steering, models generate continuations from these neutral points with a constraint of at most 128 128 new tokens . This setup ensures sufficient context for sentiment analysis without forcing a fixed generation length. A separate tuning split of 50 50 prompts was used for hyperparameter selection (see Appendix B for topic lists and prompts). Continuations are evaluated using GPT-4.1 ( gpt4 ) as a sentiment judge and GlotLID ( glotlid ) for language identification. The use of large language models for automated text annotation has been shown to outperform crowd-workers across various classification tasks ( gilardi:2023 ) , with specific validation demonstrating high human-alignment in sentiment and emotion analysis ( calderon:2025 ; ruder:2025 ) . To confirm this reliability extends to our specific low-resource settings, we conducted native-speaker validation audits (detailed in Appendix A.5 ).
Based on these automated evaluations, we report three metrics: (1) Sentiment Accuracy ( SA ) and (2) LID Rate ( LIDR ) as constituent components, and (3) Success Rate ( SR ), which serves as our primary metric for analysis. The Success Rate represents a strict intersection, requiring a generation to satisfy both correct sentiment and correct language simultaneously. Steering intensity α \alpha was optimized via grid search on the tuning split (details in Appendix A ).

blocks.en: We first evaluate the impact of our steering directions on the model’s generation. Figure 2 visualizes the sentiment distribution shifts for the Gemma-3 model across 11 11 languages using the steering direction derived from the multilingual lexicon (see Figure 7 for the corresponding distributions utilizing monolingual lexicon). With no intervention (Figure 2 a), the model generates continuations based on its intrinsic probability distribution. Since the prompts are semantically neutral (e.g., ‘He turned on the computer’), the resulting sentiments are naturally diverse or predominantly neutral. In contrast, applying the steering direction results in a dramatic distributional shift: Positive Steering (Figure 2 b) successfully aligns the majority of generations with positive sentiment, while Negative Steering (Figure 2 c) induces negative sentiment. These shifts indicate that lexicon-derived directions provide a viable basis for modulating sentiment across diverse languages. However, this responsiveness is not uniform across architectures. While the sentiment shift is nearly total in Gemma-3 , we observe varying degrees of sensitivity in Qwen-3 and Llama-3.2 (see Appendix D ). In these models, although the intervention significantly increases the target sentiment, they maintain a higher proportion of neutral generations, particularly in lower-resource languages such as Hausa ( ha ) and Sundanese ( su ). This suggests that model-specific biases and language-specific representation density play a role in the effectiveness of lexicon-derived steering.
blocks.zh: 我们首先评估我们的指导方向对模型一代的影响。 图2利用多语种词汇衍生出的指导方向,将Gemma-3模式在11个语言中的情绪分布变化可视化(使用单语种词汇的相应分布图7). 在没有介入(图2 a)的情况下,该模型根据其内在概率分布产生续作. 由于提示是完全中立的(如: " 他打开了电脑 " ),由此产生的情绪自然是多种多样的或主要是中立的。 相形之下,应用指向导致剧变的分布:正向指向(图2b)成功使大多数代人产生正向情绪,而正向指向(图2c)诱发负向情绪. 这些转变表明,由词汇衍生出的方向为调和不同语言的情绪提供了一个可行的基础。 然而,这种反应能力在各架构之间并不统一。 虽然Gemma-3的情绪变化几乎是完全的,但我们在Quen-3和Llama-3.2中观察到了不同程度的敏感性(见附录D)。 在这些模式中,虽然干预大大地提高了目标情绪,但他们保持了较高的中性世代比例,特别是在资源较低的语言如豪萨语(ha)和松丹塞语(su. 这表明,针对具体模式的偏见和针对具体语言的代表性密度,对词汇衍生的取向的有效性起一定作用。

blocks.en: To quantify this effectiveness, Tables 1 and 2 summarize the performance of Multilingual and Monolingual (english) steering directions. First, both strategies significantly alter the model’s behavior to align the output with the target sentiment compared to the uncontrolled baseline. Second, the Multilingual Lexicon aggregation emerges as a critical enabler for mid- and low-resource languages. This is most evident in Gemma-3 , where the Multilingual vector consistently outperforms the Monolingual counterpart in lower-resource settings. For instance, the Multilingual approach improves the success rate for Icelandic ( is ) from 62.3 % 62.3\% to 66.8 % 66.8\% ( + 4.5 % +4.5\% ) and for Basque ( eu ) from 54.7 % 54.7\% to 60.7 % 60.7\% ( + 6.0 % +6.0\% ). Even for Hausa ( ha ), we see an improvement of over 4 4 percentage points ( 54.6 % 54.6\% to 58.9 % 58.9\% ).
blocks.zh: 为了量化这种效果,表1和表2概述了多种语文和单语(英语)指导方向的绩效。 首先,两种策略都大大地改变了模型的行为,将输出与目标情绪相比于不受控制的基线. 第二,多种语言的Lexicon汇总成为中低资源语言的关键促进因素。 这在Gemma-3中最为明显,在Gemma-3中,多种语言的矢量在资源较少的环境下一直优于单语的对应方。 例如,多种语言方法提高了冰岛语的成功率(从62.3%、62.3%、66.8%(+4.5%、+4.5%)、巴斯克语(eu)从54.7%、54.7%、60.7%、60.7%、60.7%(+6.0%、+6.0% ) 。 即使是豪萨语(ha),也提高了4个百分点(54.6%、54.6%、58.9%)。

blocks.en: Interestingly, in Qwen-3 , we observe a notable boost in Indonesian ( id ), rising from 42.9 % 42.9\% to 46.8 % 46.8\% . This demonstrates that aggregating diverse lexicons creates a more robust, language-agnostic sentiment direction that helps bridge the representation gap in under-resourced languages. To ensure the robustness of these observed gains against stochastic decoding variance, we conducted rigorous statistical significance testing (Two-Sample Proportion Z-Tests) across all resource tiers. We find that the multilingual steering advantage is highly significant in Mid- and capable Low-resource regimes (see Appendix F ). While the Multilingual direction is generally superior for low-resource languages across all models, the Monolingual vector remains more effective for specific high-resource pairs, most notably Qwen-3 in Chinese ( zh ), where performance drops from 53.4 % 53.4\% to 48.0 % 48.0\% when using the Multilingual lexicon. In Llama-3.2 , the differences between Mono and Multi are often marginal in high-resource settings (e.g., 66.4 % 66.4\% vs 65.8 % 65.8\% for English). These variations suggest that the optimal steering strategy is heavily influenced by the model’s pre-training dynamics, which we analyze further in Section 5.3 .
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,在Quen-3中,我们看到印尼语(id)有显著的提升,从42.9%的42.9%提高到46.8%的46.8%. 这表明,汇总各种词汇可形成更强有力的、语言不可知的情绪取向,有助于弥合资源不足语言的代表性差距。 为确保这些观察到的增益能够有力防止有条理的解码差异,我们对所有资源级别进行了严格的统计意义测试(双样本比例Z测试)。 我们发现,在中能低资源制度中,多语种指导优势非常重要(见附录F)。 虽然多语种方向一般优于所有模式的低资源语言,但单语向量仍然对特定的高资源对等更为有效,最出名的是中文(zh)的Quen-3,在使用多语种词汇时,其性能由53.4% 53.4\%降至48.0% 48.0\%. 在Llama-3.2中,Mono和Multi之间的差别在高资源环境下常常是边际的(例如66.4% 66.4\%对65.8% 65.8\%对英语). 这些变化表明,最佳指导战略受到模型培训前动态的很大影响,我们在第5.3节对此作了进一步分析。

The left column of Figure 3 reveals that Monolingual steering is highly unstable at higher intensities. As α → 1.0 \alpha\to 1.0 , we observe widespread linguistic collapse (black cells), particularly in Qwen-3 and Llama-3.2 , where the model output becomes incoherent.
We hypothesize that this fragility stems from the high magnitude (norm) of the Monolingual steering direction. Since English sentiment representations are highly separable, the resulting steering direction encodes a “sharp” and distinct direction with a large norm.
When this high-norm vector is injected into the latent space of other languages, especially low-resource ones like Javanese where representations are less distinct, it pushes the activations far out of the natural distribution, causing the generation to break down.
blocks.zh:
图3左一栏显示,单语指向在高强度时极不稳定. 作为α → 1.0\ alpha\to 1.0,我们观察到了广泛的语言崩溃(黑细胞),特别是在Quen-3和Llama-3.2中,模型输出变得不一致.
我们假设这种脆弱性源于单语方向的高度(标准)。 由于英语情绪表达法高度可分,因此由此而来的指导方向将一个有大规范的"分明"和鲜明方向编码.
当这种高正向量被注入到其他语言的潜在空间中,特别是像Javanese这样的低资源语言,其中的表示性较不明显时,它会把活化器推向远离自然分布,导致生成分解.

blocks.en: In contrast, the Multilingual steering directions (right column) generally demonstrate superior stability. By aggregating lexicons from diverse languages, the resulting vector represents a “consensus” direction. We posit that this aggregation process often creates a dampening effect on the vector norm, particularly when the component languages have varying alignment. This strictly moderated norm allows for stronger steering intensities without shattering the model’s linguistic integrity.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,多语种方向(右栏)一般表现出优越的稳定性. 通过汇总各种语言的词典,由此产生的矢量代表了“共识”方向。 我们假定,这种汇总过程往往会对矢量规范产生抑制作用,特别是当各组成部分语言有不同的对齐时。 这种严格调整的规范可以加强指导强度,而不会破坏模型的语言完整性。

blocks.en: Gemma-3 demonstrates a unique power-stability trade-off: while achieving superior steering shifts, it is prone to linguistic collapse at α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 (Figure 3 ). This fragility stems from a massive latent scale disparity: as measured across layers in Appendix G , Gemma-3 operates in a high-variance regime ( L 2 > 10,000 L_{2}>10,000 ) compared to the compressed spaces of Llama-3.2 ( ∼ 25 \sim 25 ) and Qwen-3 ( ∼ 1,150 \sim 1,150 ). Within Gemma-3 , high-resource anchors (EN, ZH) define a “norm ceiling,” while low-resource languages like Javanese occupy a compact subspace (see Figure 8 ). Consequently, the multilingual steering signal ( ∼ 5,000 \sim 5,000 ) is 2.5 × 2.5\times larger than the native Javanese norm ( ∼ 2,000 \sim 2,000 ). At maximum intensity, this disproportionate force shatters the linguistic integrity of lower-resource representations while remaining effective for high-norm languages. This suggests that universal steering requires intensity scaling relative to a language’s native representational density.
blocks.zh: Gemma-3展现出独特的电稳定性取舍:虽然实现了优异的转向转向,但是在α = 1.0\ alpha= 1.0(图3)时,它容易发生语言崩溃. 这种脆弱性源于巨大的潜在尺度差异:如附录G各层所测出的那样,Gemma-3在高变异度(L 2 > 10,000 L_{2}>10000)条件下运作,而Llama-3.2 (- 25\sim 25)和Quen-3 (- ∼ 1,150\sim 1,150)的压缩空间则为Gemma-3,高资源锚地(EN, ZH)定义了“标准上限”,而Javanese等低资源语言则占据了紧凑的子空间(见图8)。 因此,多语种方向信号(- 5000 \sim 5000 )比原发地爪哇语规范(- 2,000 \sim 2,000 )大2.5× 2.5分. 在最大强度下,这种不相称的力量粉碎了资源较少的表达语言的完整性,同时对高规范语言依然有效. 这表明,普遍指导要求相对于语言的本土代表性密度进行强度衡量。

blocks.en: 5.3 Cross-Lingual Dynamics and Model Architecture

blocks.en: The patterns in Figure 4 reveal that a model’s pre-training priors dictate its responsiveness to multilingual aggregation. Gemma-3 exhibits the most consistent cross-lingual synergy, where multilingual vectors provide a coherent reinforcement signal for low-resource languages (e.g., ha , su ) with minimal performance drops in high-resource languages: a benefit likely rooted in its optimized sub-word vocabulary. In contrast, Qwen-3 incurs a “Specialization Penalty”; its bilingual-centric optimization for Chinese creates highly distinct representations that resist multilingual “noise,” leading to a > 5 % >5\% performance drop. For Llama-3.2 , multilingual aggregation serves as a critical bridge for mid-resource languages (e.g., is , et ) where the English vector is semantically distant, yet it remains insufficient to overcome the baseline “neutral anchor” in the lowest-resource settings ( jv , su ). This resistance occurs despite high cross-lingual vector alignment (see Appendix H ), a paradox likely driven by the model’s compressed latent scale and static layer-wise dynamics which create an internal numerical rigidity against external perturbations (see Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 图4中的模式显示,一个模型的预训前科决定了它对多语种汇总的反应。 Gemma-3展现出最一致的跨语言协同效应,多语言向量为低资源语言(如ha,su)提供连贯的强化信号,高资源语言的性能下降最少:这个好处可能植根于其优化的子词词汇. 与此相反,第Wen-3节规定了“专业惩罚”;其以双语为中心的中文优化,创造了非常独特的表述方式,抵制多语种“噪音”,导致5%>5%>+5%的绩效下降。 对Llama-3.2来说,多语种汇总是中资源语言的关键桥梁(例如,是等),因为英语矢量远近,但仍然不足以克服最低资源环境(jv, su.)的基线“中性锚地”。 这种阻力虽有高跨语言矢量对接(见附录H),但这种自相矛盾的现象可能由模型的压缩潜伏尺度和静地地层动态驱动,从而形成内部数值刚性来对抗外部扰动(见附录G)。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced multilingual sentiment lexicons as a scalable signal for cross-lingual activation steering, providing a practical alternative to sentence-level supervision where such data is unavailable. Across three model families and 11 languages, aggregated multilingual lexicons outperform English-derived steering vectors for mid- and low-resource languages, while monolingual lexicons remain preferable when a model is heavily specialized in a particular language. Our analysis further shows that successful intervention depends on internal model properties beyond surface-level similarity between sentiment directions: architectural specialization can decouple vector similarity from steering performance, and the scale mismatch between high-resource directions and compact low-resource representations can trigger linguistic collapse. These findings motivate a shift toward adaptive steering that calibrates intervention magnitude and lexicon configuration to each target language’s representational scale.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了多语种情绪词汇,作为跨语言激活引导的可伸缩信号,在没有此类数据的情况下,提供了一个替代判刑层面监督的实用办法。 在三个模范家庭和11个语言中,汇总的多语种词汇优于中低资源语言的英语出自方向矢量,而单一语言词汇在模式高度专业化于特定语言时仍然更为可取。 我们的分析还进一步表明,成功的干预取决于情感方向之间超出地表水平相似度的内部模型属性:建筑专业化可以使矢量相似度与向导性能脱钩,而高资源方向和紧凑的低资源表示之间的规模不匹配会引发语言崩溃. 这些结论促使人们转向适应性指导,使干预规模和词汇配置与每个目标语文的代表比例相称。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our experiments were conducted exclusively on open-ended sentence completion tasks using pre-trained base models. We did not evaluate the efficacy of these steering vectors on instruction-following tasks (e.g., QA, summarization) or on instruction-tuned checkpoints (Chat models). Consequently, it remains unverified whether the observed steering dynamics persist when the model is constrained by strict instruction formatting or safety alignment filters. Furthermore, our analysis is limited to efficient-scale models in the 3B–4B parameter range. It is unclear if the trade-offs between stability and potency scale linearly to larger models (e.g., 70B+ parameters), where the latent space typically exhibits greater robustness and separability.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验是完全利用预先训练过的基模进行开放式刑期完成任务的。 我们没有评估这些指导载体在指导跟踪任务(如质量保证、总结)或指导调整检查站(乍得模式)上的功效。 因此,当模型受到严格指令格式化或安全调整过滤器的限制时,所观察到的引导动力是否继续存在,这一点仍未得到证实。 此外,我们的分析仅限于3B-4B参数范围内的高效尺度模型。 目前尚不清楚的是,稳定性与强性之间的权衡是否线性地扩大到更大的模型(例如70B+参数),其中潜在的空间通常显示出更大的强性和可分性。

blocks.en: The Multilingual directions in this study were aggregated using lexicons from a specific set of 11 languages. We evaluated the steering performance only on these in-domain languages and did not assess zero-shot transferability to unseen languages (languages whose lexicons were excluded from the aggregation). Evaluating on unseen languages would be an interesting extension and would further test the universality of the resulting directions. That said, the practical impact of this limitation is modest: sentiment lexicons for new languages can be obtained reliably through word-level translation, which is substantially more accurate and less error-prone than translating full sentences. Extending the multilingual lexicon set to cover additional languages is therefore straightforward in practice, even if the present results do not directly demonstrate zero-shot transfer.
blocks.zh: 本研究的多语种方向是使用11种特定语言的词汇来汇总的。 我们只对这些域内语言进行了指导性评价,没有评估零射入隐形语言(其词汇被排除在汇总之外的语言)的可切换性。 对看不见的语言进行评价将是一个有趣的延伸,并将进一步检验由此产生的方向的普遍性。 尽管如此,这种限制的实际影响是不大的:新语言的情感词典可以通过字级翻译可靠地获得,这比整句翻译要准确得多,也不太容易出错. 因此,将多语种词汇集扩展为包括其他语言在实践中是直截了当的,即使目前的结果没有直接显示零发传输.

blocks.en:
Our evaluation relied primarily on automated classifier-based metrics to measure sentiment shift and language consistency.
First, we did not perform a deep quantitative analysis of textual fluency (e.g., perplexity) or topical relevance, meaning high sentiment scores do not guarantee that the generated text maintains semantic coherence or “naturalness.”
Second, we acknowledge that the reliability of LLM-based evaluators (e.g., GPT-4 ) degrades in low-resource settings. These models may harbor English-centric biases or lack the nuance to accurately adjudge sentiment in languages like Sundanese or Javanese. Consequently, the reported success rates in these languages reflect the evaluator’s probability distribution but may not perfectly correspond to native-level perceptions of sentiment.
blocks.zh:
我们的评价主要依靠基于分类器的自动衡量标准来衡量情绪转变和语言一致性。
首先,我们没有对文字流畅性(例如:迷惑性)或专题相关性进行深入的定量分析,这意味着高感分数不能保证生成的文字保持语义上的一致性或“自然性”。 “
第二,我们承认,基于LLM的评价者的可靠性(例如GPT-4)在低资源环境下会下降。 这些模式可能隐藏以英语为中心的偏见,或缺乏精确判断Sundanese或Javanese等语言情绪的细微度. 因此,所报告的这些语言的成功率反映了评估者的概率分布,但可能不完全符合当地人对情绪的看法。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
Our methodology relies on aggregating sentiment lexicons ( NRC-VAD ) which are constructed via automated translation from English without recalibrating valence scores for the target cultures. Consequently, the resulting “universal” vectors inherently propagate an Anglocentric definition of sentiment .
By projecting English sentiment values onto other languages, we risk enforcing a homogenized alignment where concepts deemed “positive” in Western norms override local cultural nuances (e.g., definitions of politeness or positivity in Javanese that differ from English).
Users of this method should be mindful that the “universality” achieved here is mathematical rather than cultural; the method prioritizes cross-lingual robustness over cultural precision, potentially risking cultural erasure in low-resource languages by aligning them to a foreign sentiment standard.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法依赖于汇编情感词汇(NRC-VAD),这些词汇是通过英语的自动翻译而构建的,没有为目标文化调整价值分数。 因此,由此产生的“普遍”媒介本身就传播了一种以英格鲁为中心的情绪定义。
通过将英语情绪值投射到其他语言上,我们冒着实施同质调合的风险,即西方规范中被认为“积极”的概念凌驾于当地文化细微差别之上(例如,在爪哇语中与英语不同的礼貌或否定性的定义)。
这种方法的使用者应当注意,这里所实现的“普遍性”是数学而不是文化上的;这种方法将跨语言的强性置于文化精度之上,有可能通过使其符合一种外感标准而冒用低资源语言进行文化消亡的风险。

blocks.en: While this study aims to improve cross-lingual control, activation steering is a dual-use technology. The same mechanisms used to enforce positive sentiment can be inverted to amplify toxicity or hate speech. Furthermore, as noted in our limitations, our current evaluation does not guarantee semantic coherence. Deploying such steering methods in production without rigorous fluency and safety checks could lead to the generation of superficially “positive” but nonsensical or hallucinated content, potentially degrading user trust.
blocks.zh: 虽然这项研究旨在改进跨语言控制,但激活引导是一种双重用途技术。 用于加强积极情绪的相同机制可以倒置来扩大毒性或仇恨言论。 此外,正如我们的局限性所指出,我们目前的评价不能保证语义上的一致性。 在没有严格流畅和安全检查的情况下在生产中使用这种指导方法,可能导致产生表面的“正性”但不具感想或幻觉的内容,有可能降低用户的信任。

blocks.en: All artifacts used in this study are restricted to their intended research purposes. The code libraries are utilized under standard open-source licenses (e.g., MIT, Apache 2.0), and all datasets and pre-trained models are accessed in strict accordance with their original creators’ terms of use.
blocks.zh: 本研究使用的所有文物都仅限于预定的研究目的. 根据标准开源许可证(如麻省理工学院、Apache 2.0)使用代码库,所有数据集和经过预先培训的模型严格按照其原始创建者的使用条件访问。

blocks.en: A.1 Model and Implementation
blocks.zh: A.1 模式和实施

blocks.en: All models ( Llama-3.2-3B , Gemma-3-4B-PT , and Qwen3-4B-Base ) were implemented using the transformers library ( wolf:2020 ) in bfloat16 precision. We specifically utilize the base (pre-trained) versions to investigate sentiment representations in the foundational latent space, thereby avoiding biases from instruction-tuning or RLHF. Because all evaluated models are in the ∼ \sim 3 3 B to 4 4 B parameter range, they require approximately 16 16 GB of VRAM for inference and activation steering. We distributed the experiments across several computing environments based on resource availability: publicly available cloud notebooks (dual NVIDIA T4, 2 × 16 2\times 16 GB), commercial cloud GPU instances (NVIDIA RTX A4500, 20 GB), and a shared academic compute cluster (NVIDIA DGX-A100).

blocks.en: A.2 Data and Lexicon Preprocessing
blocks.zh: A.2 数据和Lexicon预处理

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 3.1 , we specifically utilize the multilingual NRC-VAD lexicon ( nrc-vad:2018 ) to obtain the sentiment direction. The NRC-VAD lexicon provides human ratings for valence, arousal, and dominance, with scores ranging from 0 0 to 1 1 . In our experiments, we investigate the efficacy of cross-lingual steering by comparing two distinct lexicon configurations: monolingual and multilingual .
blocks.zh: 正如第3.1节所讨论,我们特别利用多语言的NRC-VAD词汇(nrc-vad:2018)来获得情绪方向. NRC-VAD词典提供人类对华丽,振奋和支配的评级,分数从0分到11分不等. 在我们的实验中,我们通过比较两种不同的词汇组合,即单一语言和多语种,来调查交叉语言引导的效果.

blocks.en: For the monolingual configuration, we rely exclusively on English lexicon entries. The preprocessing involves removing invalid entries ( NaN values) and filtering the remaining entries based on their valence scores. Entries with a valence score > 0.8 >0.8 are assigned to the positive set ℒ + \mathcal{L}^{+} , while entries with a valence score < 0.2 <0.2 are assigned to the negative set ℒ − \mathcal{L}^{-} . We deliberately employ these strict thresholds to maximize the semantic contrast between the opposing sets, ensuring that the resulting steering direction is robust and not diluted by neutral or weakly polarized terms.
blocks.zh: 对于单一语言的配置,我们完全依靠英语词汇条目. 预处理涉及去除无效的条目(NaN值)并根据其值分来过滤其余条目. 有等值分数 > 0.8分 > 0.8分的条目被分配到正数集L +\ mathcal{L}^{+};有等值分数 < 0.2分 < 0.2分的条目被分配到负数集L-\mathcal{L}^{-}. 我们刻意地使用这些严格的阈值来使对立的套数之间的语义对比最大化,确保由此而来的指导方向坚固而不会被中性或弱分化的术语所稀释.

blocks.en: For the multilingual configuration, we aggregate lexicon entries from 11 languages, selected to cover a spectrum from high-resource to low-resource languages: English ( en ), German ( de ), Chinese ( zh ), Japanese ( ja ), Indonesian ( id ), Icelandic ( is ), Estonian ( et ), Basque ( eu ), Hausa ( ha ), Javanese ( jv ), and Sundanese ( su ). The preprocessing for the aggregated set involves a rigorous deduplication process. First, we identify and remove ambiguous duplicates: entries appearing in multiple languages that exhibit conflicting valence scores (i.e., one instance having a score < 0.2 <0.2 and another > 0.8 >0.8 ). Second, for duplicates with consistent sentiment polarity (both < 0.2 <0.2 or both > 0.8 >0.8 ), we retain only the first occurrence. From this refined set of unique multilingual entries, we construct ℒ + \mathcal{L}^{+} and ℒ − \mathcal{L}^{-} using the same valence thresholds ( > 0.8 >0.8 and < 0.2 <0.2 ) as the monolingual configuration.
blocks.zh: 对于多语种配置,我们从11种语言汇总词汇条目,选取以涵盖从高资源语言到低资源语言的频谱:英语(en),德语(de),汉语(zh),日语(ja),印度尼西亚语(id),冰岛语(eanish),爱沙尼亚语(et),巴斯克语(eu),豪萨语(ha),爪哇内斯语(jv)和苏丹语(su. 集合集的预处理涉及严格的分解过程. 首先,我们查明并删除模棱两可的重复:以多种语言出现的条目,其价值分数相互冲突(即一个案例的分数 < 0.2 < 0.2,另一个案例 > 0.8 > 0.8)。 第二,对于情绪一贯极性(均 < 0.2 < 0.2或两者 > 0.8 > 0.8)的重复,我们只保留第一次发生。 从这一套精炼出的独特多语种条目中,我们构建了L +\ mathcal{L}^{+}和L-\mathcal{L}^{-}使用与单一语言配置相同的等值阈值( > 0.8 > 0.8和 < 0.2 < 0.2).

blocks.en: We constructed a multilingual evaluation suite consisting of 1000 neutral prompts across 11 languages. We utilized Gemini to generate 10 categories and 100 sub-topics, which served as the foundation for creating 1,000 neutral evaluation sentences. The full list of categories and prompts is provided in Appendix B . These were subsequently translated into 10 target languages, with specialized prompts for low-resource languages (Hausa, Javanese, Sundanese) to ensure linguistic naturalness. To ensure the neutrality of the baseline, we manually audited a random sample of 100 prompts. While the majority were neutral, we observed that approximately 3% contained implicit sentiment (e.g.,“The departure board showed the flight was ‘delayed”’ or “A client reported an issue with the software”). These instances highlight that while Gemini generates objectively factual statements, certain real-world contexts carry inherent negative or positive connotations.
blocks.zh: 我们建造了一个多语种评价套件,由11种语言的1000个中性提示组成。 我们利用双子座生成了10个类别和100个分专题,这成为创建1000个中性评价句的基础. 类别和提示的完整清单见附录B。 这些语言后来被翻译成了10种目标语言,为低资源语言(Hausa, Javanese, Sundanese)提供了专门的提示,以确保语言自然性. 为了确保基线的中立性,我们手动审核了100个提示的随机抽样。 虽然大多数人是中立的,但我们注意到,大约3%的人有隐含的情绪(例如, " 离境板显示飞行被`延迟 ' 了,或 " 一个客户报告了软件的问题 " )。 这些情况突出表明,虽然双子星产生客观的事实性陈述,但某些现实世界的背景具有固有的消极或积极含义。

blocks.en: A.3 Steering Methodology Details
blocks.zh: A.3 指导方法细节

blocks.en: For layer selection, we split the activation dataset into training ( 70 % 70\% ) and validation ( 30 % 30\% ) sets using stratified sampling with a fixed random state ( 1331 1331 ). Probes were implemented as Logistic Regression models via scikit-learn , utilizing a StandardScaler and a liblinear solver with L1 regularization (C=1.0) initialized with the same fixed seed. Importantly, L1 regularization in this layer-probing stage is employed solely to mitigate overfitting in the high-dimensional activation space and improve probe generalization. The actual isolation of sparse neurons is handled exclusively by the non-linear XGBoost attribution.
blocks.zh: 为了进行层层选择,我们将激活数据集分为培训(70%-70%-%)和验证(30%-30-%)两个集,使用分层抽样,固定随机状态(1331-1331)。 探测器是通过scikit-learn执行的逻辑回归模型,使用一个标准分解器和一个L1正规化(C=1.0)以相同的固定种子初始化的liblinear解析器。 重要的是,在这一层探测阶段,L1正规化仅仅是为了减缓高维活化空间的过度适应,并改进探测通俗化。 稀有神经元的实际隔离完全由非线性XGBoost归属处理.

blocks.en: For each layer, neuron-level attribution uses an XGBoost model ( chen:2016 ) with a binary:logistic objective, trained on all lexicon entries of 𝒟 ( i ) \mathcal{D}^{(i)} for 100 100 boosting rounds with learning rate η = 0.1 \eta=0.1 , maximum tree depth 3 3 , and random seed 1331 1331 ; all other hyperparameters are left at their library defaults (including λ = 1 \lambda=1 and γ = 0 \gamma=0 ). Neuron importance is computed with XGBoost ’s gain importance, i.e., the average split gain over all splits that use the neuron. We retain only the neurons with non-zero gain, which yields a sparse set of neurons for steering.
blocks.zh: 对于每层,神经元级的归属使用XGBoost模型(chen:2016),具有二进制:后勤目标,对所有词典条目D (i)\mathcal{D}^{(一)}进行了100个助推回合的培训,学习率为 η = 0.1\eta=0.1,最大树深为 3,随机种子为 1331 1331;所有其他超参数都留在其库默认值(包括 λ = 1\lambda=1和 γ = 0\gamma=0). 神经元的重要性是用XGBoost的增益来计算的,即使用神经元的所有分数的平均分得收益。 我们只保留非零增益的神经元, 它产生少量的神经元用于向导。

To ensure highly stable and reproducible sampling trajectories despite the stochastic nature of the decoding process, all generation runs were executed with a fixed global random seed ( 1331 1331 ) initialized across Python , NumPy , and PyTorch . The steering intensity α \alpha was tuned via grid search on a 50 50 -prompt tuning split. Based on the highest Success Rate (our primary metric), we selected α = 0.5 \alpha=0.5 for monolingual steering across all models. For multilingual steering, we used α = 0.75 \alpha=0.75 for Gemma and Qwen , and α = 1.0 \alpha=1.0 for Llama .

blocks.en: A.5 Validation of LLM-as-a-Judge for Multilingual Sentiment
blocks.zh: A.5 多语种判刑法法官的认证

blocks.en: Evaluating sentiment shifts in open-ended generative text across typologically diverse languages requires a metric capable of capturing complex, context-dependent semantics. While traditional lexicon-based scoring approaches offer a highly interpretable alternative ( taboada:2011 ; liu:2012 ) , they present severe structural limitations for our specific experimental setup. Our evaluation suite spans 11 languages, including highly agglutinative systems (e.g., Basque, Japanese, Indonesian, Javanese, Sundanese) and morphologically fusional languages (e.g., Estonian, Icelandic). In these typologies, sentiment-bearing roots undergo extensive affixation and internal stem mutations, causing static dictionary engines to suffer from catastrophic surface-form miss rates without flawless, language-specific lemmatizers.
blocks.zh: 评估不同类型语言的无限制基因文字的情绪变化,需要一个能够捕捉复杂、依赖上下文的语义的衡量标准。 虽然传统的基于词典的分分法提供了极易解释的替代方法(taboada:2011;liu:2012),但它们对我们具体的实验设置提出了严重的结构限制. 我们的评价套套间涵盖11种语言,包括高度杂质系统(如巴斯克语、日语、印度尼西亚语、爪哇语、日语)和形态聚变语言(如爱沙尼亚语、冰岛语)。 在这些类型学中,含情根会经历广泛的固定和内干突变,导致静态字典引擎遭受灾难性地表形错失率而无瑕疵,语言特异的放光剂.

blocks.en: Furthermore, lexicon approaches are inherently compositionally blind; they aggregate static token weights and struggle to resolve contextual polysemy or implicit sentiment distributed across narrative structures ( khoo:2018 ) . To overcome these limitations, we utilize an LLM-based evaluator ( GPT-4.1 ), which natively resolves morphological variants via sub-word tokenization and captures deep contextual dependencies.
blocks.zh: 此外,词汇法本质上是盲目的;它们汇集了静态符号权重并努力解决在叙事结构中分布的上下文多语或隐含的情绪(khoo:2018). 为了克服这些局限性,我们利用了基于LLM的评价器(GPT-4.1),通过子词符号化和捕捉深层上下文依赖性,在本地解决形态变体.

blocks.en: To empirically assess the reliability of our evaluation metric and address broader cross-lingual limitations noted in recent literature ( xu:2025 ) , we manually audited the GPT-4.1 judge across both high-resource (English) and low-resource (Javanese) settings. In both cases, 150 generated instances were sampled (50 per predicted sentiment class), fully randomized, and evaluated with the human annotator blinded to the model’s predictions. The English baseline was audited by one of the authors, whereas the Javanese evaluation was conducted by a volunteer native speaker recruited from the authors’ network to ensure a rigorous assessment of low-resource linguistic nuances. To ensure a fair comparison, the human annotator evaluated the text using criteria identical to the LLM judge (detailed in Appendix C ). The annotator provided verbal consent for their labels to be used for research validation; no personal or demographic data was collected.
blocks.zh: 为了实证地评估我们评价指标的可靠性并解决最近文献(xu:2025)中所指出的更广泛的跨语种限制,我们手动对GPT-4.1法官进行了高资源(英语)和低资源(Javanese)设置的审计. 在这两种情况下,150个生成的病例被取样(每个预测的情绪类别50个),完全随机化,并与人类注释者一起评价模型的预测。 其中一位作者对英语基线进行了审计,而Javanese的评价是由一位志愿母语者从作者网络中招聘的,以确保严格评估资源不足的语言细微差别。 为确保进行公平的比较,人文注释员使用与LLM法官相同的标准(详见附录C)对案文进行了评估。 注释员口头同意将其标签用于研究验证;没有收集个人或人口数据。

blocks.en: Table 4: Confusion matrices for the GPT-4.1 sentiment judge across 150 randomized samples per language.
blocks.zh: 表4:每种语言150个随机抽样的GPT-4.1情绪判断器的迷惑矩阵。

blocks.en: The detailed confusion matrices (Table 4 ) provide deeper insight into the model’s error distribution across resource tiers. While there is an expected performance drop in the low-resource Javanese setting (achieving a macro-average precision of 78 78 %), the matrix reveals that errors are predominantly boundary confusions between polar and neutral classes rather than severe polar inversions. For instance, the judge only predicted a positive sentiment for a true negative sample in 7 7 out of 150 150 instances, maintaining excellent directional precision for negative sentiment shifts ( 92 92 %). These empirical findings confirm that despite the structural complexities of low-resource languages, the contextual LLM judge provides a highly reliable metric for capturing directional sentiment shifts.
blocks.zh: 详细的混淆矩阵(表4)更深入地了解模型在资源层次上的错误分布。 虽然低资源Javanese设置的预期性能会下降(实现宏观平均精度78.78%),但矩阵揭示出错误主要是极地和中地类之间的边界混淆,而不是严重的极地倒置. 例如,在150起案例中,法官仅预测了7起真实的负面抽样,保持了对负面情绪变化的极好的方向精确性(92%)。 这些经验结论证实,尽管低资源语言的结构复杂,但背景的LLM法官为记录取向性情绪变化提供了非常可靠的衡量标准.

blocks.en: Appendix B Prompts and Dataset Topics
blocks.zh: 附录B 提示和数据集主题

blocks.en: B.1 Prompts for Data Generation

blocks.en: We utilized specific prompts to generate the categories, topics, and neutral sentences. For low-resource languages (Hausa, Javanese, Sundanese), a specialized translation prompt was used to ensure stylistic accuracy.

blocks.en: 1. Category and Topic Generation Prompt I would like to conduct an experiment to examine whether a Large Language Model (LLM) can be steered to generate positive or negative continuations from neutral prompts. Please suggest 10 suitable topic categories, each containing 10 broad subcategories that can serve as a basis for constructing neutral prompts. I plan to create 10 prompts for each subcategory; therefore, the subcategories should remain general and widely applicable rather than overly specific. For reference, I prefer the subcategories to be phrased in a style similar to the examples below: • Preferred style (broad and illustrative): 1. Morning routine (waking up, breakfast, commuting) 2. House chores (cleaning, cooking, laundry) 3. Daily commute (bus, train, traffic) 4. Leisure activities (reading, walking, hobbies) 5. Communication (texting, calling, chatting) 6. Time management (schedules, delays, appointments) 7. Weather and environment (rain, heat, wind) 8. Personal interactions (neighbors, family, friends) 9. Weekend activities (shopping, rest, recreation) 10. Unexpected daily events (forgotten items, late arrivals) • Less preferred style (too narrow or fragmented): 1. Morning routines 2. Commuting (bus, train, car) 3. Household chores (e.g., laundry, dishes) 4. Running errands 5. Grocery shopping 6. The weather forecast 7. Receiving mail or a package 8. Walking in the neighborhood 9. Preparing a simple meal 10. The end of the day

blocks.en: Appendix C Sentiment Evaluation Guidelines
blocks.zh: 附录C 评价准则

blocks.en: To ensure a rigorous and fair comparison between the automated metric and human evaluation, both the GPT-4.1 judge and the human annotator evaluated the generated texts using identical task descriptions and sentiment definitions.
blocks.zh: 为了确保对自动计量和人的评价进行严格而公平的比较,GPT-4.1法官和人文注释员都使用相同的任务说明和感情定义对生成的文本进行评价。

blocks.en: C.1 LLM Judge Prompt
blocks.zh: C.1 LLM 法官即时

blocks.en: We used GPT-4.1 to evaluate the sentiment of the generated texts. The model was provided with a system instruction to act as a precise classifier and a user prompt containing detailed definitions and constraints. The full prompt structure is provided below: Sentiment Evaluation Prompt Template System Message: You are a precise sentiment analysis classifier. User Message: You are an expert linguist acting as a sentiment judge. The user will provide a text that may be in {language} or a mix of languages. Task: Analyze the text and classify its dominant sentiment based on the definitions below. If the text contains multiple parts (e.g., instructions, questions, and narrative), focus on the sentiment conveyed by the main narrative content or the generated statement , ignoring purely instructional phrasing (like ‘‘Answer:’’, ‘‘Choose A/B’’, etc.). Definitions: - ‘‘Positive’’: The text expresses a positive evaluation, such as indicating that the situation, action, or object is good, helpful, safe, beneficial, desirable, comfortable, satisfying, or otherwise favorable. The evaluation may be explicit (e.g., ‘‘I am happy’’) or implicit (e.g., ‘‘the process is efficient’’). - ‘‘Negative’’: The text expresses a negative evaluation, such as indicating that the situation, action, or object is bad, difficult, harmful, inconvenient, frustrating, disappointing, risky, undesirable, or otherwise unfavorable. The evaluation may be explicit (e.g., ‘‘I am angry’’) or implicit (e.g., ‘‘the system is confusing’’). - ‘‘Neutral’’: The text is purely factual, informative, descriptive, or consists of neutral questions/instructions without emotional valence. Constraint: The answer must be exactly one word from this list: [Positive, Negative, Neutral] Text to analyze: {sentence} Answer:
blocks.zh: 我们用GPT-4.1来评价生成的文本的情绪. 向该模型提供了系统指示,以作为精确的分类器和载有详细定义和限制的用户提示。 完整的即时结构如下: 提示评价快速模板系统消息 : 你是一个精确的情绪分析分类。 用户信件 : 你是一个专家语言学家 作为情绪判断。 用户会提供可能使用{语言}或混合语言的文本. 任务 : 根据以下定义分析文本并分类其主导情绪. 如果文字包含多部分(如:指令,问题和叙事),则关注主要叙事内容或生成的语句所传达的情绪,而忽略纯粹的指令用词(如:-AnA/B’’A/Choose A/B’’等). 定义: - 积极性 : 案文表达了积极的评价,例如表明情况、行动或目标是好的、有益的、安全的、有益的、可取的、舒适的、令人满意的或有利的。 评价可以是明确的(例如,`I'是`快活'),也可以是隐含的(例如,`过程'是高效率的)。 - 虚构的: 案文表示负面评价,例如指出情况、行动或物体是坏的、困难的、有害的、不方便的、令人沮丧的、令人失望的、危险的、不受欢迎的、或不利的。 评估可以是明确的(例如,`I'是生气的'),也可以是隐含的(例如,`系统'是混淆的')。 - 纽特拉尔: 案文纯粹是事实性的、信息性的、描述性的,或由没有感情价值的中性问题/指示所组成。 约束:答案必须是本列表中一个字的准确性: [Positive, Nublicinary]. 要分析的文本 : {判决} 回答 :

blocks.en: Our results demonstrate that multilingual steering directions consistently influence the sentiment distribution across all three models, shifting the probability mass toward the target sentiment compared to the baseline. blocks.en: In this section, we provide a rigorous statistical analysis of our evaluation results to confirm that the observed performance deltas between multilingual and monolingual steering directions are statistically significant and not artifacts of stochastic decoding variance. We also provide a granular analysis of model behavior in low-resource regimes.

blocks.en: F.1 Stochastic Decoding and Corpus-Level Stability

blocks.en: To evaluate the impact of our steering interventions, our experimental pipeline utilizes a massive sample footprint. For each language condition, we conduct N = 2,000 N=2,000 independent generation trials (derived from 1,000 1,000 distinct prompts × \times 2 target sentiments).

blocks.en: While decoding parameters remain stochastic, evaluating across thousands of distinct, independent generation episodes leverages the Law of Large Numbers. Local, token-level variance effectively averages out at the corpus level. This stabilizes the observed success rates (SR), allowing them to closely converge toward the true expected performance of the steered model and minimizing the impact of seed-to-seed variance.

blocks.en: F.3 The Low-Resource Performance Spectrum in Latent Space
blocks.zh: F.3 后期空间的低资源性能光谱

blocks.en: While the statistical significance holds firmly where models exhibit baseline capacity, individual language conditions in extreme low-resource regimes occasionally exhibit marginal absolute performance differences (e.g., + 0.1 +0.1 to + 0.3 +0.3 percentage points). Rather than indicating methodological failure, our analysis shows these variations reflect a clear architectural spectrum of base model capacity:
blocks.zh: 虽然在模型显示基线能力的地方,统计意义是牢固的,但极端低资源制度中的个别语言条件有时显示出微不足道的绝对性能差异(例如+0.1+0.1至+0.3+0.3个百分点)。 我们的分析没有表明方法上的失败,而是表明这些变化反映了一个明确的基本模型能力的建筑范围:

blocks.en: • The Floor Effect (e.g., Qwen-3 Hausa): At a success rate of just 1.8 % 1.8\% , Qwen-3 experiences a foundational downstream alignment failure in Hausa. Crucially, its baseline Language Identification Rate remains high (LIDR > 60 % >60\% ), indicating the model recognizes the linguistic context. However, the underlying semantic features are not sufficiently robust within the latent space to support targeted linear interventions. In this extreme regime, the steering vector lacks a mature geometric representation to act upon, resulting in statistically insignificant variance (e.g., a marginal + 0.3 +0.3 pp delta). • Neutral Transfer Equivalence (e.g., Gemma-3 Javanese): In contrast to the floor effect, Gemma-3 possesses functional baseline capacity in Javanese, maintaining a stable success rate of roughly 37.8 % 37.8\% . The marginal + 0.1 +0.1 pp delta represents a regime of representation equivalence . In this condition, both the cross-lingual multilingual vector and the monolingual vector achieve matching directional utility in the residual stream, resulting in stable, net-neutral transfer. • Positive Cross-Lingual Transfer (e.g., Gemma-3 Hausa): When a base model crosses the necessary capacity threshold to respond robustly to interventions in a low-resource language, the architectural advantage of the multilingual lexicon becomes highly visible, delivering the statistically significant boost of + 4.3 +4.3 percentage points verified in the previous section.
blocks.zh: • 地板效应(例如:Quen-3 Hausa): Quen-3在豪萨遭遇了基础下游对接失败。 关键的是,其基线语言识别率仍然很高(LIDR > 60% > 60\%),表明模型承认语言背景. 然而,潜在的空间内潜在的语义特征不足以支持有针对性的线性干预。 在这种极端的制度中,向量缺乏成熟的几何表达法来采取行动,导致统计上微不足道的差异(例如边际+0.3+0.3 pp delta). • 中立转移等同性(例如Gemma-3 Javanese): Gemma-3在Javanese拥有功能基线能力, 边值+0.1+0.1 pp delta代表一种代表等同的制度。 在此条件下,跨语言多语言向量和单语言向量在残流中都实现了相匹配的方向性活性,从而实现了稳定的,网中立的转移. • 积极跨线转移(例如Gemma-3 Hausa): 当一个基础模型跨越必要的能力阈值,以低资源语言对干预措施作出有力反应时,多语种词汇的建筑优势就变得非常明显,在统计学上实现了上一节所核实的+ 4.3+4.3个百分点的显著提升.

blocks.en: To understand the physical “intensity” of steering interventions, we calculate the L 2 L_{2} norm of the steering direction vectors at each layer. As shown in Figure 8 and 9 , the models exhibit vastly different latent space scales and layer-wise dynamics.
blocks.zh: 为了了解指导干预的物理“强度”,我们计算了每层方向向量的L 2 L_{2}规范。 如图8和图9所显示的,这些模型呈现出巨大的不同的潜在空间尺度和分层动态。

blocks.en: G.1 Scale and Specialization Ceiling
blocks.zh: G.1 规模和专业上限

blocks.en: The absolute magnitude of steering vectors varies by three orders of magnitude between architectures, despite their comparable hidden dimensions ( 2560 2560 neurons for Gemma-3 and Qwen-3 ; 3072 3072 for Llama-3.2 ). Specifically, Gemma-3 operates in a high-variance regime with norms peaking over 10,000 10,000 in its middle layers, whereas Qwen-3 exhibits a moderate scale (peaking near 1,150 1,150 ) and Llama-3.2 utilizes a highly compressed space with norms remaining below 25 25 . In all models, the norm magnitude is positively correlated with language resource levels and model specialization. The Chinese ( zh ) steering direction consistently defines the “norm ceiling” in Qwen-3 ( ∼ 1,150 \sim 1,150 ) and Llama-3.2 ( ∼ 24 \sim 24 ), followed closely by English ( en ). This suggests that the model’s most specialized features are encoded with the highest numerical weights.
blocks.zh: 转向向量的绝对分量在结构之间因三个相去相去相去相去相去相去之多而相去相去之多,尽管其可比较的隐藏尺寸(Gemma-3和Quen-3为2560个神经元;Llama-3.2为3072个). 具体地说,Gemma-3在高变相制度下运作,其中层的规范为10,000多起,而Quen-3显示的尺度适中(接近1,150 1,150起),而Llama-3.2则利用高度压缩的空间,规范保持在25下。 在所有模型中,规范的分量与语言资源水平和模型专业化呈正相关. 中文(zh)向导一致地定义了"规范天花板"(Quen-3 (∼ 1,150\sim 1,150)和"Llama-3.2 (∼ 24\sim 24)"),紧接后是英文(en. 这表明该模型最专业的特征被编码为数字权重最高.

blocks.en: The significant disparity in steering effectiveness between models can be partially attributed to this internal scaling of their latent spaces. As illustrated in Figure 8 , the absolute magnitude of steering vectors in Gemma-3 is several orders of magnitude larger than those in Llama-3.2 and Qwen-3 . This suggests a “stretched” or high-variance latent space where semantic features are represented with massive numerical weights. Such high-intensity representations may make specific features easier for the model’s attention mechanisms to prioritize during token generation, explaining its responsiveness to sentiment steering.
blocks.zh: 不同模型在指导效力方面的巨大差异可部分归因于其潜在空间的内部规模。 如图8所示,Gemma-3的转向向量的绝对量级比Llama-3.2和Quen-3的多。 这表明一个“伸缩”或高变异的潜在空间,其中语义特征具有大量的数值加权。 这种高强度的表述可能使模型的注意机制更容易在象征性生成时确定优先次序,并解释其对情绪引导的反应。

blocks.en: While Figure 8 illustrates the total latent scale, evaluating the non-zero gain vectors (Figure 9 ) reveals the concentrated “active” magnitude of the steering interventions. Filtering for non-zero gains reduces the L 2 L_{2} norm magnitudes drastically across all architectures: Gemma-3 drops from > 10,000 >10,000 to peak values around 500 500 . Similarly, Qwen-3 reduces from ∼ 1,150 \sim 1,150 to < 50 <50 , and Llama-3.2 drops from ∼ 25 \sim 25 to < 2.5 <2.5 . Despite this massive reduction in absolute magnitude, the hierarchical relationship between the architectures ( Gemma > > Qwen > > Llama ) remains strictly preserved, confirming that Gemma-3 ’s high-variance regime is a fundamental architectural property rather than an artifact of inactive neurons.
blocks.zh: 虽然图8说明了总体潜在规模,但评价非零增益矢量(图9)揭示了指导性干预措施的集中“活性”规模。 过滤非零收益会大幅降低L 2 L_{2} 规范的大小 : Gemma-3 从 > 10,000 > 10,000降至500,500左右的最高值。 同样地,Quen-3将1,150\sim 1,150减少到 < 50 < 50,而Llama-3.2则从-25\sim 25减少到 < 2.5 < 2.5。 尽管绝对数量大幅下降,但建筑之间的等级关系(Gemma > > Quen > > Llama)仍然严格保存着,证实Gemma-3的高变相制度是基本建筑财产,而不是非活性神经元的文物.

blocks.en: G.2 The Compactness of Low-Resource Representations
blocks.zh: G.2 低资源代表性的趋同性

blocks.en: In stark contrast to the high norm ceilings of English and Chinese, the Javanese ( jv ) direction possesses the smallest norm magnitude across all architectures: below 5 5 in Llama-3.2 and below 200 200 in Qwen-3 . This suggests that low-resource languages occupy a physically more compact region of the latent space. We hypothesize that the “linguistic collapse” observed at high steering intensities for Javanese occurs because external vectors (often scaled to high-resource norms like English) effectively “over-steer” these compact clusters, pushing activations far beyond their natural boundaries.
blocks.zh: 与英语和汉语的高标准天花板形成鲜明对比的是,Javanese (jv)方向拥有所有建筑中最小的规范级:Llama-3.2低于5个,Quen-3低于200个. 这表明,低资源语言占据着潜在空间中实际更为紧凑的区域。 我们假设,在Javanese高方向强度下观察到的“语言崩溃”之所以发生,是因为外部矢量(通常被放大到像英语这样的高资源规范)实际上“过度地”这些紧凑的集群,推动激活远远超出其自然界限。

blocks.en: G.3 Layer-wise Dynamics
blocks.zh: G.3 分层动态

blocks.en: The models demonstrate distinct temporal profiles for sentiment representation: • Static Encoding ( Llama & Qwen ): These models exhibit a “step-function” behavior. In Llama-3.2 , the sentiment direction is fully established by Layer 1, and in Qwen-3 by Layer 6 6 , remaining static until the final layers. This implies sentiment is treated as a global, invariant attribute. • Dynamic Progression ( Gemma ): Gemma-3 shows a “bell-curve” progression where the norm builds through the initial layers, peaks between Layers 15 15 and 25 25 , and tapers off toward the output. This indicates a more dynamic semantic refinement process.

blocks.en: While dense vectors exhibit static “step-functions” ( Llama , Qwen ) or “bell-curves” ( Gemma ) as shown in Figure 8 , isolating the non-zero gain vectors reveals a different temporal dynamic. As illustrated in Figure 9 , the non-zero gain magnitude steadily increases in the deeper layers across all three models. This indicates that while the global sentiment direction may be established early in the network, the concentrated, manipulable weights required to effectively steer that sentiment accumulate and scale up significantly toward the later layers.
blocks.zh: 如图8所示,密集向量呈现出静态“步态函数”(Llama, Quen)或“钟曲线”(Gemma),而将非零增益向量隔离,则揭示出不同的时间动态。 如图9所示,所有三个模型的更深层中,非零增量稳步增加。 这表明,虽然全球情绪的取向可能在网络早期确定,但有效引导这种情绪向后层积累和大幅扩展所需的集中而可操纵的分量。

blocks.en: G.4 Optimal Layer Configuration Asymmetry Between Steering Directions.
blocks.zh: G.4 引导方向之间的优化地层配置不对称.

blocks.en: Another consequence of this norm disparity is visible in the optimal layer configurations reported in Tables 5 and 6 . Across nearly all models and languages, the best-performing monolingual (English) steering direction requires fewer layers (e.g., top- 5 5 or top- 50 50 %) to reach its optimal success rate, whereas multilingual directions more often require intervention across all layers. This phenomenon is visually supported by both our dense and sparse norm analyses. As shown in Figure 8 , the English steering direction consistently exhibits a substantially larger L 2 L_{2} norm than the multilingual direction at comparable layers. This disparity is further corroborated by the non-zero gain vectors (Figure 9 ), which explicitly map the optimal intervention zones. Within these optimal middle-to-late layers, the concentrated, non-zero magnitude of the English direction (blue) remains distinctly higher than that of the multilingual direction (pink) across all three architectures. Because the magnitude of the injected monolingual perturbation is definitively larger, fewer layers of intervention are needed to displace the model’s activations sufficiently to shift sentiment. Conversely, the multilingual direction, being comparatively dampened in norm, requires broader layer-wise application to achieve its optimal steering efficacy.
blocks.zh: 表5和表6所报告的最佳地层布局可以看出这一标准差异的另一个后果。 在几乎所有的模型和语言中,表现最优的单语(英语)向导需要更少的地层(如:上-5 5或上-50 %)来达到最佳成功率,而多语取向更需要跨地层干预. 我们的密集和稀少的规范分析从视觉上支持了这一现象。 如图8所显示的,英文方向显示的L 2 L_{2)的规范比可比层次的多语文方向大得多。 非零增益向量(图9)进一步证实了这一差异,它明确描绘出最佳干预区。 在这些最优的中后层内,英语方向(蓝色)的集中,非零等分度仍然明显高于所有三种建筑的多语言方向(平克). 由于注射单一语言扰动的规模绝对更大,需要较少层次的干预才能使模型的活化足以改变情绪。 反之,在规范方面受到相对抑制的多语种方向需要更广泛的分层应用,以达到最佳指导效果。

blocks.en: Interestingly, this norm-layer relationship does not hold uniformly in Llama-3.2 for several languages (Icelandic, Basque, Hausa, Javanese, Sundanese), where the optimal monolingual configuration in fact requires more layers than the multilingual counterpart. This anomaly may be attributed to the relatively high cross-lingual vector alignment observed in Llama-3.2 between English and low-resource language (see Section H ). For instance, the gap between English–Javanese similarity and Multilingual–Javanese similarity is markedly smaller in Llama-3.2 ( 0.970 − 0.968 = 0.002 0.970-0.968=0.002 ) than in Gemma-3 ( 0.987 − 0.983 = 0.004 0.987-0.983=0.004 ) or Qwen-3 ( 0.937 − 0.912 = 0.025 0.937-0.912=0.025 ). Because the English steering direction in Llama-3.2 is already nearly as aligned with low-resource languages like Javanese as the multilingual consensus direction is, monolingual injection is comparatively less destructive than in the other architectures. Consequently, it can tolerate broader layer-wise application without triggering the linguistic collapse observed elsewhere.
blocks.zh: 有趣的是,对于几种语言(冰岛语,巴斯克语,豪萨语,爪哇内斯语,松达内塞语)来说,这种规范层关系在Llama-3.2中并不统一,那里最理想的单一语言配置实际上比多语种对应语言需要更多的分层. 这种异常可能归因于在Llama-3.2中观察到的英语和低资源语言之间相对较高的跨语言向量对齐(见H节. 例如,在Llama-3.2(0.970 − 0.968 = 0.002 0.970-0.968 = 0.002)中,英文-Javanese相似度与多语-Javanese相似度之间的差距明显小于Gemma-3(0.987 − 0.983 = 0.04 0.987-0.983= 0.004)或Quen-3(0.937-0.912 = 0.025 0.937-0.912=0.025)的差距。 由于Llama-3.2的英语方向已经和多语种共识方向一样,与Javanese等低资源语言相对应,所以单语注入比起其他架构的破坏性要小. 因此,它可以容忍更广泛的分层应用,而不会引发其他地方观察到的语言崩溃。

blocks.en: H.2 Multilingual Dampening Effect
blocks.zh: H.2 多种语言的降雨效应

blocks.en: The similarity data supports our “consensus” hypothesis regarding the robustness of multilingual steering. By aggregating diverse lexicons, the resulting vector moves toward a shared centroid, effectively dampening the high-norm “sharpness” characteristic of monolingual directions. This effect is most pronounced in Qwen-3 /Chinese, where the specialized, high-intensity monolingual signal is diluted by the lower-norm profiles of the broader lexicon. While this dampening enhances stability across the “long tail” of languages, it accounts for the observed Specialization Penalty in high-resource anchors, where the reduced vector magnitude fails to meet the model’s native representational threshold.
blocks.zh: 相似性数据支持我们关于多语种指导力的“共识”假设。 通过汇总不同的词典,产生的矢量向一个共享的百分数移动,有效地抑制了单一语言方向的高规范的"快"特征. 这种效果在Quen-3 / Chinese中最为突出,其中特有,高强度的单一语言信号被更广义的词典的下层规范剖面所稀释. 虽然这种抑制会增强语言 " 长尾 " 的稳定性,但它是高资源锚地观察到的专业化惩罚的原因之一,因为降低的矢量没有达到模型的本土代表性阈值。

blocks.en: Appendix I Establishing the Causal Relevance of Targeted Intervention Sites
blocks.zh: 附录一 确定目标干预地点的因果关系

blocks.en: I.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: I.1 实验设置

blocks.en: As briefly introduced in Section 3.2 , we performed a causal intervention experiment to verify that our isolated layers and neurons actively govern model generation rather than inducing arbitrary changes or gibberish output. We conducted this experiment using the multilingual direction across two low-resource setups: Gemma-Hausa and Qwen-Javanese . We randomly sampled 50 prompts from our broader 1,000-prompt evaluation set and steered them toward both positive and negative targets, yielding 100 paired evaluation instances per model. To isolate the causal effect of our XGBoost -selected neurons, we established our proposed method against two rigorous null-hypothesis baselines:
blocks.zh: 正如第3.2节所简要介绍的,我们进行了一个因果干预实验,以核实我们孤立的地层和神经元积极管理模型生成,而不是诱发任意的改变或bber输出. 我们用多种语言进行实验, 我们随机抽取了我们范围更广的1 000个即时评价组合中的50个提示,并引导它们朝着正负两个目标方向前进,每个模型得出100对评价实例。 为了隔离我们XGBoost-所选神经元的因果效应,我们针对两个严格的虚伪基线确定了我们拟议的方法:

blocks.en: • Proposed Method ( H 1 H_{1} ): Intervene strictly on the top-50% probe-ranked layers, using only the specific sparse neurons isolated by XGBoost . • Fully Random Baseline ( H 0 ( 1 ) H_{0}^{(1)} ): Intervene on a randomly sampled 50 50 % of the layers across the architecture, using a completely random subset of neuron indices of identical size ( | 𝒩 i | |\mathcal{N}_{i}| ). • Layer-Controlled Baseline ( H 0 ( 2 ) H_{0}^{(2)} ): Intervene on the exact same top- 50 50 % probe-ranked layers, but replace the XGBoost -selected coordinates with a random subset of neuron coordinates of identical size ( | 𝒩 i | |\mathcal{N}_{i}| ).
blocks.zh: • 拟议方法(H 1 H_{1}): 严格在上-50%的探测分层进行干涉,只使用被XGBoost隔离出的特定稀有神经元. • 完全随机基线(H 0 (1) H_{0 (1)}): 在随机抽取了整个架构上50-50%的地层,使用一个完全随机的大小相同的神经元指数子集(QQ N i | |\ mathcal{ N}_{i}| }|). • 控制层基线(H0 (2) H_{0 (2)}): 在完全相同的上- 50 % 探测器排名的地层上进行干涉, 但将 XGBoost - 选定的坐标取而代之的是大小相同的神经元坐标的随机子集( | N i | |\ mathcal{ N}_{i}| }| }|) 。

blocks.en: I.2 Metrics and Statistical Significance
blocks.zh: I.2 计量和统计意义

blocks.en: We evaluated causal efficacy using two metrics: Sentiment Accuracy (whether the generated sentiment matches the intended target) and Strict Success Rate (SR) (whether the text matches the target sentiment and retains the correct Language ID, ensuring no language-switching or gibberish occurred). Because the experimental outcomes are paired and binary, we applied McNemar’s test to evaluate statistical significance against a standard threshold of p < 0.05 p<0.05 .
blocks.zh: 我们用两个衡量标准来评估因果关系:感知精确度(生成的情绪是否与预定目标相匹配)和"严格成功率"(SR)(文本是否与目标情绪相匹配并保留正确的语言ID,确保不发生语言切换或bber取). 由于实验结果成对和二进制,我们运用了McNemar的测试来评价统计意义,标准阈值为p < 0.05 p < 0.05。

blocks.en: Table 8 and Table 9 summarize the outcomes against the fully random and layer-controlled baselines, respectively. For both Gemma-Hausa and Qwen-Javanese, our proposed method ( H 1 H_{1} ) significantly outperforms both the fully random ( H 0 ( 1 ) H_{0}^{(1)} ) and layer-controlled ( H 0 ( 2 ) H_{0}^{(2)} ) baselines in Sentiment Accuracy ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ). By demonstrating that steering via these specific neurons changes model behavior in a predictable, task-relevant manner compared to random controls, we confirm that these representations are causally relevant, addressing concerns regarding correlative probing ( ravichander:2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 表8和表9分别对照完全随机和分层控制的基线概述了结果。 对于Gemma-Hausa和Quen-Javanese来说,我们拟议的方法(H 1 H_{1})大大地超越了感官精确度中完全随机(H 0 ( 1) H_{0}^{(1)})和地层控制的基线(H 0 ( 2) H_{0}^{(2)}) (p < 0.05 p < 0.05 ) 。 我们通过证明通过这些特定的神经元进行引导可以预测和任务相关的方式改变模型行为,从而证实这些表述与随机控制是因果相干,解决了对亲和亲和性的关切(rawchander:2021 ) 。

blocks.en: In Gemma-Hausa, our method yields a highly significant improvement in Strict Success Rate ( p < 10 − 8 p<10^{-8} ). Randomly perturbing neurons or layers frequently broke the Language ID or induced gibberish, whereas targeting our probe-selected neurons successfully flipped the sentiment while keeping the language generation intact.
blocks.zh: 在Gemma-Hausa案中,我们的方法在严格成功率(p < 10 - 8 p < 10-X-8})方面有显著改善。 随机扰动的神经元或地层经常会打碎语言ID或诱发的胡言乱语,而针对我们探测器选择的神经元则成功地翻转了情绪,同时保持了语言生成的完整.

blocks.en: For Qwen-Javanese, the strict success rate difference was not statistically significant. This aligns directly with our findings in Table 6 , which demonstrates that Qwen has an overall Javanese baseline Success Rate of only 9.8 9.8 %. Because the base model inherently struggles to maintain Javanese text generation, any representation steering is bottlenecked by the model’s underlying language generation capabilities. Crucially, however, the Sentiment Accuracy remains statistically significant ( p = 0.0107 p=0.0107 and p = 0.0003 p=0.0003 ), demonstrating that the targeted features do encode sentiment even when the base model’s language constraints limit full generation success.
blocks.zh: 对Quen-Javanese来说,严格的成功率差异在统计学上并不显著。 这与我们在表6中的调查结果直接吻合,该表显示,Quen的总的爪哇语基线成功率仅为9.8% 9.8%。 由于基础模型在本质上难以维持Javanese文本生成,任何表示方向被模型的基本语言生成能力所束缚. 然而,关键是,感官精确度在统计学上仍然很重要(p=0.0107p=0.0107和p=0.0003p=0.0003),这表明即使基准模型的语言限制限制了完全生成成功,目标特征确实编码了情绪。

blocks.en: Appendix J Isolating the Multilingual Advantage from Vector Norm and Scaling Effects
blocks.zh: 附录J 将多种语言从矢量规范中分离出来并放大效果

blocks.en: Given the high cosine similarity between the monolingual and multilingual vectors as discussed in Section H , it is critical to determine whether the observed “multilingual advantage” is driven by true cross-lingual semantic directions or if it is an artifact of vector norm differences and alpha scaling ( α \alpha ). To isolate the geometric impact of the vector direction from these scaling factors, we present controlled experiments executed on Gemma-3 for Hausa (ha). Hausa serves as a representative low-resource setting where the base model demonstrates robust performance, ensuring a reliable baseline environment to analyze steering dynamics.
blocks.zh: 鉴于H节所讨论单一语言和多语种矢量之间的高同位素相近性,必须确定观察到的“多语种优势”是由真正的跨语言语义取向所驱动,还是是由矢量规范差异和α缩放(α\α)所形成。 为了将矢量方向的几何影响从这些缩放因子中分离出来,我们提出了为Hausa(ha)在Gemma-3上执行的控制实验. Hausa是一种具有代表性的低资源环境,在这种环境中,基准模型表现出强劲的业绩,确保有一个可靠的基线环境来分析指导动态。

blocks.en: J.1 Structural Divergence in Steering Pipelines
blocks.zh: J.1 引导管道的结构差异

blocks.en: Our two-stage feature attribution mechanism independently derives the optimal layer configurations and their corresponding active neuron masks for both setups. Consequently, the selected subset of target layers inherently differs. As illustrated in Figure 11 , the top-50% layer sets for the monolingual and multilingual directions exhibit structural divergence across all evaluated models. Specifically, the layer-wise Jaccard similarity is 0.70 0.70 ( 14 14 of 20 20 shared active layers) for Gemma-3 , 0.40 0.40 ( 8 8 of 20 20 shared) for Llama-3.2 , and 0.80 0.80 ( 16 16 of 20 20 shared) for Qwen-3 .
blocks.zh: 我们的两阶段特性归属机制 独立地获得 最佳的地层配置 和相应的 活性神经元口罩 两个设置。 因此,目标层的选定子集本质上有所不同。 如图11所示,单一语言和多语言方向的上-50%层显示所有评价模型的结构差异。 具体来说,地层相近的Jaccard相似性为:Gemma-30.70(20个共享活性地层中的14个14个),Llama-3.20.40(20个共享地层中的8个8个),Quen-30.80(20个共享地层中的16个16个).

blocks.en: Furthermore, even when both setups select the exact same layers, the specific active neurons targeted within those layers diverge substantially. To isolate this neuron-level divergence, we analyze the middle network layer for each model (using 0 0 -based indexing): Layer 16 16 for Gemma-3 , Layer 13 13 for Llama-3.2 , and Layer 17 17 for Qwen-3 (Figure 12 ). We chose these specific middle layers because they are independently identified as active target layers by both the monolingual and multilingual setups. By examining layers where the selection perfectly aligns, we provide an objective baseline to demonstrate that layer-level agreement does not guarantee neuron-level agreement. Within these shared layers, the active neuron masks exhibit minimal overlap (all J ≤ 0.34 J\leq 0.34 ). This proves that the two setups steer fundamentally distinct internal processing pathways, rather than the multilingual vector acting as a merely scaled version of the English circuit.
blocks.zh: 此外,即使两个设置选择了完全相同的地层,这些地层中针对的具体活性神经元也有很大的不同。 为了隔离出这个神经元相位分,我们分析每个模型的中层网络层(使用0-基于索引): 第16层为Gemma-3, 第13层为Llama-3.2, 第17层为Quen-3(图12). 我们选择了这些特定的中间层,因为它们被单语和多语种组合独立地确定为活性目标层. 通过检查选择完全吻合的地层,我们提供了一个客观的基线,以证明地层级协议不能保证神经元级协议. 在这些共享地层中,活性神经元口罩的重叠度最小(所有J 0.34 J\leq 0.34)。 这证明,这两个设置指导着根本不同的内部处理路径,而不是多语种向量作为英语电路的缩放版本。

blocks.en: These results demonstrate that while the norm effect is present (rescaling the English vector yields a minor gain in sentiment accuracy ( 60.8 60.8 % → \rightarrow 61.3 61.3 %)), it cannot fully close the performance gap. In high-dimensional LLM activation spaces, near-collinear cosine similarities can mask orthogonal directional components. Minor directional shifts in this high-dimensional space carry a unique cross-lingual utility that cannot be replicated by scalar adjustments to a monolingual vector.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,虽然规范效应存在(缩小英语向量在情绪准确度方面产生微小的增益(60.8 60.8% =\rightarrow 61.3 61.3%)),但它不能完全弥合性能差距. 在高维LLM活化空间中,相近的连线性同位素相似性可以遮住正向元件. 这个高维空间中微小的方向性转变带有独特的跨语言用途,不能被单语言向量的scalar调整所复制.

blocks.en: During our investigations, severe linguistic collapse (manifesting as non-words, punctuation loops, or degenerate repetitive sequences) emerged under two distinct experimental contexts. To clarify the failure modes discussed in the main paper, we decouple our preliminary baseline observations from the formal hyperparameter sweep.
blocks.zh: 在我们的调查中,在两种不同的实验背景下出现了严重的语言崩溃(作为非文字操作、发音循环或退化的重复序列)。 为了澄清主要文件中所讨论的故障模式,我们将初步基线观测与正式的超参数扫描脱钩。

blocks.en: 1. Ablation of Sparse Selection (Dense Intervention): In Section 3.2 (the Sparse Neuron Selection via Non-linear Attribution paragraph), we argue that dense intervention (steering all neurons indiscriminately) injects excessive noise into foundational syntax circuits. As shown in the top half of Table 11 , preliminary baselines applying vectors across all neurons consistently resulted in syntax breakdown. Because this dense configuration universally failed to produce evaluable text even at low intensities ( α ≤ 0.5 \alpha\leq 0.5 ), it was excluded from the main evaluation sweep. 2. Magnitude Oversaturation (Figure 3 Black Cells): Even when successfully isolating features via sparse selection (e.g., non-zero gain neurons), excessive steering multipliers force the model outside its operational distribution. In Figure 3 , these autoregressive collapses are visually encoded as black cells.
